Download **SynthScan-Setup-Windows-x64.exe**. There is one installer, with all features selected by default. Uncheck anything you do not want.

- Live Mining Recognition is clearly tagged **SCREEN READING**. Leave it unchecked to install the screen-free engine without capture providers or recognition models. Server HUD, hangars, reputation, blueprints and piracy do not require OCR.
- Optional providers follow your selection; desktop/HUD navigation adapts to installed features. Change your choices later in **Feature modules**. Updates preserve your selection, with verified downloads, rollback and local records kept in AppData.
- Includes the current mission/wallet ledger and HUD, SynthStrings patch guard and recovery, People improvements and shard names. Configured rewards, observed changes, unavailable readings and community estimates remain distinguished.
- Settings keeps Privacy & Capture in one place and removes redundant launch/toggle buttons. Personal Notes has been removed entirely. The existing feature-picker design is retained.
- No usage tracking, analytics beacon or consent prompt. GitHub's ordinary download counters remain available to the publisher.

All module ZIPs and migration ZIPs below are for automatic installation/update. You do not need to download them manually. Existing Standard/Full installations retain their reader choice during automatic migration.

This is a community **alpha**, with signed update metadata but no trusted Windows publisher certificate. Windows can still show a reputation warning. Download only from this repository; do not disable antivirus. Shared UI/calculations remain in Core; this is not an OS sandbox or an independent security certification. See the module guide and installation audit in the repository for details.
